newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr marginally weakened against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.

It posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.40 against the dollar versus 6.39 last week. It said after a currency auction on October 26, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the currency auction in the period October 28 to November 3 would be 6.40 to the dollar.
The bank posted the birr against the pound at a mean rate of 10.2182 from 10.2022 last week.
